title: Updating the walk length
statement: For any register state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, replacing coordinate $10$ of its register-value vector by $z$ yields the register-value vector of the state obtained by replacing its walk length by $z$.
replaced:
Let $σ$ be a record of fifteen natural-number registers, and let $R(σ)$ list its
registers in order, with the walk length at coordinate $10$. Replacing coordinate $10$
of $R(σ)$ by $z$ gives the register vector of the record obtained from $σ$ by replacing
its walk length by $z$.
